projects.name: STON.fi
facts: Peak supply pressure lands in months 24-36, where DAO treasury, team and investor unlock windows overlap.
projects.allocation: Allocation (100M STON): Investors 31% (pre-seed 21 + private 10), DAO 50% (Treasury 20, Incentives 10, Marketing 10, Operations 10), Team & Advisors 19%. Vesting: DAO Treasury locked/staked 24 months then linear; Team 24-mo lock + 36-mo linear; Investors 12-mo cliff + 24-mo linear; Incentives linear over 5 years; Marketing 2M immediate + 8M over 3 years; Operations 4M immediate + 6M over 5 years.

facts: Second unlock phase (from Nov 2025) roughly doubles circulating supply; daily unlock inflow exceeds buyback capacity ~5.5x.
